human_model.corpus: hg38 sequence plus observed ATAC/DNase across 11 human cell/primary contexts and 8 tissues, supervised with epigenomic, transcriptional and chromatin-contact assays
human_model.corpus_annotation_state: Publication accession workbook available but not cryptographically bound to the checkpoint

input_eligibility.gse289173: The sealed feature contract contains snRNA-derived context and QTL summaries but no topology-matched observed ATAC/DNase. Native EPCOTv2 cannot run and cannot earn the sealed champion claim. Adding a proxy after outcomes or selection are visible is prohibited.
input_eligibility.gse296875: Same-nucleus ATAC can support development-only observed-ATAC comparisons. It does not turn EPCOTv2 into RNA-conditioned ATAC, and held-donor ATAC must be offered to matched baselines.
input_eligibility.variant_scoring: The same observed ATAC tensor must be used for REF and ALT. A variant-bin mask is required as a prespecified sensitivity analysis because unmasked ATAC may encode the regulatory consequence being evaluated.

interpretation: No released corpus evidence indicates that human_model.pt was trained on GSE289173 snRNA, eQTL or interaction-eQTL labels, but the checkpoint upload occurred 19 days after the accession became public. The target-label-unexposed classification is therefore medium confidence and must be revisited after donor/accession alias resolution. Regardless of exposure, the current sealed source lacks the observed ATAC input required for native EPCOTv2 inference.

noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.drjieliu_mirror: drjieliu/EPCOTv2-app contains a byte-identical human_model.pt, but later app edits and ownership do not replace the paper-linked luosanj checkpoint provenance or supply missing terms.
noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.mouse_checkpoint: ddp_mouse_full.pt is a separate species model and is out of scope for human MASLD champion selection.
noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.published_eqtl_classifier: The article describes classifiers built from EPCOTv2 representations, variant-to-TSS features and added scores, but no exact frozen classifier checkpoint is in the admitted release. Reimplementing that head is development training, not zero-shot EPCOTv2.
